				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>A little bit more about us &#8230;</strong></p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>THE RESORT LAYOUT</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>We can offer you both a relaxing holiday and an active vacation that combines sea, sun, wellness, yoga and kitesurfing.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3 two-col-tab et_pb_equal_columns">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_3  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>70 m inside of the beach:</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>The bungalows, the yoga studio, the swimming pool, the main restaurant and bar are located in a large verdant plot dotted with with mature Ficus, Flamboyant and Coconut Palm trees less than 100 m. from the sensational beach of Paje. It is the perfect place to regenerate away from the beach folk and its nicely protect from the monsoon winds</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_4  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>on the beach front:</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_6  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>You can reach the beach in a minute walk along a narrow sandy path. At the beach front you will find our kite centre &#8211; Hakuna Matata Kiteschool. Here you can kitesurf or hire a sup and enjoy the seaview. </p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="restaurantandbar" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_2 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_4 two-col-tab et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters3">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_5  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_0">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img decoding="async" fetchpriority="high" width="1080" height="1440" src="https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=1080%2C1440&#038;ssl=1" alt="" title="IMG_2469" srcset="https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?w=1920&ssl=1 1920w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=225%2C300&ssl=1 225w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=768%2C1024&ssl=1 768w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=1152%2C1536&ssl=1 1152w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=1536%2C2048&ssl=1 1536w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=1080%2C1440&ssl=1 1080w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=1280%2C1707&ssl=1 1280w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=980%2C1307&ssl=1 980w, https://i0.wp.com/pajebynight.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_2469-scaled.jpg?resize=480%2C640&ssl=1 480w" sizes="(max-width: 1080px) 100vw, 1080px" class="wp-image-3227" data-recalc-dims="1" /></span>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_6  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_7  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Paje by Night Restaurant &amp; Bar</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_8  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>The restaurant is open daily<br />&#8211; from 08:00 to 22:00 &#8211;</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_9  et_pb_text_align_justified et_pb_text_align_center-phone et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>As the previous owners were Italian, the restaurant offers many Italian dishes. Think about homemade pasta, ravioli, lasagne and wood-fired pizza. Living on an island fish and seafood fresh from the ocean also play an important role in our menu. Since it is a tropical island big healthy salads are a must. Not to disappoint anyone, we also offer meat recipes and to honour the island traditions there is a selection of Swahili dishes.<br />The menu is a la carte.</p>
<p>Breakfast in served from 8 to 10 am. We offer Full breakfast, Vegan breakfast and Gluten free breakfast.</p>
<p>The Bar offers good music, cocktails, a selection of  wines and beers, soft drinks and 100% fresh fruit sugar free tropical juices and smoothies minute made with the fruit that our island seasonally offers.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_5 two-col-tab et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters3">

				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_10  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>The  bar is open daily<br />&#8211; from 8 AM until 10 PM &#8211;</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_11  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>EVERY MONDAY BAZAAR: FROM 5PM A LOCAL MARKET + FROM 7:30PM LIVE MUSIC AND FOR THE HUNGRY GUESTS A SWAHILI BUFFET (35.000 TSH)</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_12  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p> EVERY THURSDAY ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT PIZZA NIGHT 6-10PM  30.000 TSH</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_13  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>From 4 to 6 PM it&#8217;s happy hour from our special cocktail menu!</p></div>

			</div><div id="poolandgarden" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_3 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_row et_pb_row_6">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_9  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_15  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Pool &amp; Garden</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_7 two-col-mob two-col-tab">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_10  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_16  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>. The swimming pool and the Jacuzzi are shaded by Indian almonds trees and coconut palms. Its water is always amazingly fresh and if you travel on the hottest months of the year, when even the ocean is a tea pot, you will certainly love it. It features different depth so everyone can enjoy. The tide changes can be huge: don&#8217;t be surprised when you want to go for a swim and there is no water because the the tide is out. Or you want to go for a walk, but there is no beach :). </p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_11  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_17  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>The Garden is mature with plenty of green and hammocks to enjoy at any time of the day and night. You are likely to encounter some red Colobus Monkeys – please do not feed them – and chameleons if you search carefully.  At night, with your nose up, stargazing is another beautiful option and let us know if you would like to have a private romantic dinner by the fire place.</p></div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_row et_pb_row_14">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_25  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_25  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Live Events</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_26  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Monday&#8217;s Bazaar: a market with local vendors, live music and a Swahili buffet!</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_27  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Starting at 5pm with a market with local vendors. Around 7pm the band will start while the kitchen set up the buffet. Serve yourself a variety of the local Swahili dishes while enjoying the band from your table by the pool, and maybe do a little dance with your feet in the sand afterwards. </p></div>
			</div>
